title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-002-008
doc_notes: This document is a collection of correspondence and requests for information sent to the FAA regarding the November 17, 1986, JAL UFO sighting, including internal FAA memos and public inquiries.

incidents.summary: Japan Air Lines (JAL) flight 1628 cargo jet reported being shadowed by two belts of light and a huge spaceship while crossing into Alaska airspace.
incidents.quote: JAL Capt. Kenjyu Terauchi reported on Nov. 17 that his Boeing 747 cargo jet was shadowed by two belts of light
